short_description: Install APKs and split bundles with shell privileges via Shizuku, on-device Wireless ADB or root — installer-identity spoofing, security scan and ad neuter.
detailed_description:
Shell Installer installs APKs with **shell-level privileges** — the same path as `adb install` — using Shizuku, on-device Wireless ADB, or root. No PC required.

- Split bundles (.apk, .apks, .xapk, .apkm, .zip)
- Installer-identity spoofing presets (Google Play, Galaxy Store, AppGallery, Amazon)
- Offline security verdict + optional VirusTotal lookup
- Ad/tracker neuter (permission revoke + app-op restrictions)
- Live OLED-style install log
developer_message: Built by MoshEZeeD — feedback and bug reports welcome on GitHub.
